Good safaris begin
with good people.
localStory.body1: Mambeu is locally owned and operated. We share Tanzania through expertly guided journeys, personal attention and a commitment to responsible travel.
localStory.body2: From your first ideas to the route, stays and special moments, we bring local knowledge to the details that matter.

head.label: THE PEOPLE BEHIND YOUR JOURNEY
head.text: Mambeu Safaris is locally owned and based in Arusha, sharing the country we call home through personal wildlife, mountain, cultural and beach journeys.

about.storyPhotoAlt: Mambeu guests and safari vehicle in Tanzania

story.paragraph1: Founded by local Tanzanians, Mambeu brings a close connection to Tanzania’s landscapes, wildlife and communities. Our team plans bespoke journeys through the places we know and love.
story.paragraph2: We welcome different budgets and travel styles. We help choose routes, stays and activities around your comfort, interests and time available.
story.paragraph3: Responsible tourism is part of our approach: respecting wildlife, supporting local communities and making meaningful connections with the places you visit.

values.title: Personal by design
values.text: Your dates, interests and comfort level shape the journey. We listen first, then help you connect the details.

values.title: Rooted in Tanzania
values.text: Local knowledge helps us choose routes, stays and experiences that work together.

values.title: Travel responsibly
values.text: Respect for nature and communities guides how we share Tanzania with our visitors.

mission.lead: We create personalised travel experiences that showcase Tanzania’s natural beauty and cultural richness, with comfort, safety and local insight.
mission.body: Our vision is to grow through thoughtful service and responsible tourism, supporting local communities while sharing the country’s extraordinary places.

head.label: HOW YOU STAY
head.text: Midrange and comfort are at the heart of our approach. Luxury and camping remain part of the possibilities. Choose how you want your journey to feel.

comfortSection.eyebrow: YOUR SAFARI. YOUR KIND OF STAY.
comfortSection.introLine1: Midrange and comfort at our heart.
comfortSection.introLine2: Luxury when you want a little more.

balanceSection.lead: Your budget influences accommodation, length of stay and optional experiences. We’ll help you decide where extra comfort makes a difference.
balanceSection.body: The published journeys are starting points. When you enquire, we’ll suggest specific lodges and tented camps for your dates and confirm what is included before you book.

head.label: WHERE WE TAKE YOU
head.text: Legendary wildlife parks, mountain landscapes and an Indian Ocean coast. Connect your favourite places into one personal journey.

head.label: BEYOND THE GAME DRIVE
head.text: Add experiences that mean something to you, from cultural connections to a different view of the plains.

head.label: PLAN WITH CONFIDENCE

head.label: START THE CONVERSATION
head.text: Share a few details and we’ll help shape a personal quotation. You can send your message by WhatsApp or email when you’re ready.

aside.intro: Share what you know. We’ll help with the rest.
aside.step3Detail: Confirm the details with our team.

form.fineprint: Review your enquiry below, then send it through WhatsApp or your email app. Nothing is sent until you do.
form.previewIntro: Review the details, then choose how to send your message to Mambeu.

kilimanjaro.label: MOUNTAIN ADVENTURES
kilimanjaro.text: A Kilimanjaro adventure with personal preparation, local guiding and support along the way.
blocks: Share your hiking experience, fitness and questions with our team.
Discuss route options, duration, equipment and preparation before confirming your climb.
Add a wildlife safari or a Zanzibar stay to round off your adventure.

splitSection.lead: Mambeu’s mountain experiences bring expert guiding, equipment and preparation together with a personal approach.
splitSection.body: Tell us about your hiking background, preferred dates and available time. We’ll discuss suitable routes, support and preparation before providing your quotation.

zanzibar.label: SAFARI & ISLAND ESCAPES
zanzibar.text: Pair your wildlife adventure with Zanzibar’s beaches, historic Stone Town and the Indian Ocean.
blocks: Unhurried days, warm waters and accommodation matched to your comfort level.
Explore Stone Town, local flavours and the island’s spice heritage.
Ask about snorkelling, diving and excursions for your travel dates.

splitSection.lead: Build a Zanzibar stay around your interests, from beach relaxation to cultural exploration and time on the water.
splitSection.body: Accommodation, flights, airport transfers and excursions can be discussed together so your safari and island stay connect smoothly.
